hook: Delays, platform changes, a closed restaurant car: catch the one detail that matters when a station announcement crackles overhead.
intro: A station announcement of about 150 words — heard once, the way you hear it on a platform, here through the speaker voice. Announcements and information spoken to a group are among the most useful things to understand on a trip. This one packs six pieces of information into four short paragraphs: the delay and its reason, the changed platform (nicht Gleis vier, sondern Gleis sieben — nicht … sondern is the correction pattern), what passengers with a connection should do, where the bicycle spaces are today, and what is happening with the restaurant car. The passive and the formal imperative are the grammar of announcements: Reisende … werden gebeten …; Getränke werden am Platz verkauft; Bitte beachten Sie … Listen for the numbers and for the word after sondern and aber — that is where the information changes.
tips[0].title: The announcement script
tips[0].text: Achtung, eine Durchsage … · … hat leider … Minuten Verspätung · Grund dafür ist … · fährt nicht von Gleis …, sondern von Gleis … · Bitte beachten Sie … · Wir bitten um Ihr Verständnis.
tips[0].check.why: The fixed phrase is … hat … Minuten Verspätung: the train is ten minutes late.
tips[1].title: nicht … sondern, aber = the correction
tips[1].text: The first piece of information is the old one, the one after sondern or aber is valid today. Announcements do this all the time: the first number or place is the one that no longer applies.
tips[1].check.why: The time after sondern is the valid one; the first time is the old plan.
tips[2].title: The passive tells you what happens to you
tips[2].text: werden gebeten (are asked), werden verkauft (are sold): announcements describe what is done, not who does it. The verb at the end carries the information.
tips[2].check.why: werden gebeten means you are asked; the verb at the end, einzusteigen, says what to do: get on.
remember[0]: Delay, reason, platform, connection, bicycles, restaurant: six slots, six questions.
remember[1]: nicht … sondern / aber: the second piece of information is the real one.
exam: Station and tour announcements like this are a standard listening text in the B1 exam — and on every delayed train.
tips[1].check.q: „Der Zug fährt heute nicht um 9.10 Uhr, sondern erst um 9.40 Uhr.“ When does it leave today?
tips[2].check.q: „Fahrgäste werden gebeten, hinten einzusteigen.“ What should you do?
tips[2].check.options[2]: Wait at the back of the platform.
